capabilities: Open and render .html and .htm files inside vault tabs
Sanitize HTML content through five selectable operating modes
Convert and open MHTML (.mht/.mhtml) files on the fly
Persist form-control values back into the HTML file
Zoom, search, and auto-reload the opened HTML file
disambiguation: Not a web clipper or page-saver; it only renders HTML files that already exist in the vault.
extras: Warns that Unrestricted Mode is 'very dangerous and may cause the Obsidian app crash'; local images cannot load due to Obsidian constraints; only standard HTML5, SingleFileZ, and MHTML files are supported. Form state persistence is disabled by default.
problem: Obsidian cannot display local HTML files stored in the vault, so saved web pages can't be read inside the app.

relations.evidence: this plugin also use this library to convert MHTML files
re-save the HTML file as a complete HTML file by dedicated browser extensions

summary: File viewer that opens and renders .html and .htm files in the vault, with sandboxed security modes, MHTML conversion, zoom, search, and form state persistence.
